scenes.en: A very common worry. Let's check.
scenes.say: Do glasses make your eyes weaker? It's a very common worry. Let's check the facts.

scenes.en: Once you wear glasses, your power keeps going up because of them.
scenes.say: The myth: once you start wearing glasses, your power keeps going up because of them.

scenes.en: Glasses only bend light to focus it. They don't change your eye.
scenes.say: The fact: glasses only bend light, so it focuses on the retina. They don't change the shape or strength of your eye.

scenes.en: Kids' eyes are still growing. After 40, the eye's lens gets stiffer.
scenes.say: So why does power change? In children, the eyeball is still growing. And after about forty, the lens inside the eye gets stiffer, so reading up close gets harder. This happens with or without glasses.

scenes.en: Skipping glasses won't make eyes stronger. In young kids it can affect how vision develops.
scenes.ta: குழந்தைகள் கண்ணாடி அணியாவிட்டால் பார்வை வளர்ச்சி பாதிக்கலாம்
scenes.say: Did you know? Skipping your glasses won't make your eyes stronger. You'll just squint and strain. And in young children, not wearing needed glasses can affect how vision develops.

scenes.en: Wear glasses as advised. Kids: check every year. Adults: check regularly.
scenes.say: So, wear your glasses as advised. Get children's eyes checked every year, and adults regularly.
